QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Heliseum Reclamation HQ
QuestInfo.0: Get the low-down on Heliseum Reclamation HQ from #bBeldar#k.
QuestInfo.1: Now that you're a member of Heliseum Reclamation HQ, meet up with #bTiron#k at the #bTransitional Dimensional Door#k for guidance.
QuestInfo.2: You met Tiron, but there's a problem.

0.0: You already know, but that vile Magnus invaded and took over Heliseum, our capital. We're using our temple, Pantheon, as our base until we can take the city back.
0.1: We've been slowly gathering our forces as powerful warriors like Kaiser or Angelic Buster appeared, and we think we're finally ready to take the fight to Magnus and reclaim Heliseum.
0.2: However, it wasn't easy as we thought... Magnus's Specter forces are too strong. We've been waiting for the Apostle of Justice...for you to join. You've given us confidence. We will defeat Magnus this time, and reclaim Heliseum.
0.3: We'll need you to join the main force. #bTiron#k at the #bTransitional Dimensional Door#k will guide you to Heliseum Reclamation HQ, and from there, you can talk to the two commanders.

0.msg: Go up the stairs on the right, take the portal to Heliseum, and find Tiron near the Transitional Dimensional Door. Good luck.

1.msg: #b(So, the rumors are true. The timing is perfect... it's a true chance to reclaim Heliseum.)#k\r\n

1.0: T-trouble! S-someone help! Hurry! Specters! Specters everywhere!

0.msg: A-are you here to help us? We've been cut off from the two commanders at HQ and, well... we don't know what to do now!\r\n

1.msg: Calm down, kid. I'm going to help. Now, what happened to the commander at HQ?\r\n

default.0: Go up the stairs on the right, take the portal to Heliseum, and find #bTiron#k near the #bTransitional Dimensional Door#k. Good luck.\r\n
